resources.string: Logs Uber and Lyft ride offers on this phone.

While offer tracking is switched on in Waypoint, this reads the Uber and Lyft driver apps only: it logs each ride offer and whether you took it, and records their on-screen text, your taps, and a screenshot when an offer appears. It ignores all other apps, never taps or types for you, and nothing leaves this phone unless you share it yourself.
